items.name: Norwegian Championship 2021
items.information: The wait is over, the championship is finally here... Can you solve a cube? Then sign up and join us at the Norwegian Championship 2021! To be safe, we don't want too many spectators. Therefore we encourage you not to come unless you're accompanying a competitor Ventetiden er over, mesterskapet er endelig her... Kan du løse en kube? Ja så meld deg på og bli oss på Norgesmesterskapet 2021! For å være trygge ønsker vi ikke mange tilskuere. Derfor anbefaler vi dere å ikke komme med mindre dere følger en deltaker.

items.information: Welcome to Norwegian FMC Championship 2023! This special competition is held the weekend before the Norwegian Championship 2023, and the only event is fewest moves because this is the only event missing from Norwegian Championship 2023. By holding this competition the weekend before Norwegian Championship 2023, we have enough time to do three attempts (mean of 3) and declare a true Norwegian champion in the event. To include as many people as possible, the competition will be held in three different cities at the same time: Oslo, Trondheim and Sandnes.

items.name: Norwegian Championship 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaHFKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c60c36a3fbfb1c2f2d10ce4665856be2a51bbe19/Artboard%201.png) ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Norgesmesterskapet i Kubing 2024, for første gang holdt i Sandnes! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta på NM. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39270-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). ### Staffing Vi kommer til å trenge frivillige som kan bidra med ulike oppgaver under arrangementet. De som bidrar på dette teamet vil få ulike goder, blant annet refundert registreringsavgift. Les [Staffing-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39280-staffing) for mer info. --- ## 🇬🇧 Information Welcome to the Norwegian Cubing Championship of 2024, held in Sandnes for the first time. The competition is open to all who wish to compete regardless of nationality. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete in the Norwegian Championship. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39270-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab. ### Staffing We are going to need volunteers to help with different tasks during the competition. Those who chose to be a part of this team will get perks such as a refunded registration fee. Read the [Staffing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39280-staffing) tab for more info.

Konkurransen er open for alle som ynskjer å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet. ### Førstegongsdeltakarar Førstegongsdeltakarar er hjarteleg velkomne til å delta på NM. Det blir ikkje stilt krav om kor rask ein må vere for å delta, og vi ynskjer å sjå flest mogeleg velje å delta. Vi oppmodar alle førstegongsdeltakarar til å lese [fana for førstegongsdeltakarar](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2026#74970-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇬🇧 Information Welcome to the Norwegian Cubing Championship of 2026, this time back in Trondheim.
